description: Patch releases of the Anki synchronization server this role installs are not going to be automerged, because the Docker image is provided by the third party, not by the upstream developers team. While the image is (currently) created based on the official source code, it is not ensured that it will be so, regardless whether it passes Molecule tests or not. We want to make sure that every update actually aligns with the upstream before being merged, as there seems to be some unspoken tension between the image provider and the team. For background history, see: https://github.com/ankitects/anki/pull/2798
